name: Baton Rouge Expansion
monitor_reason: endpoints/location (threshold b) not established; single origin (EIA); mainline status unclear
researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 75: Baton Rouge Expansion, Mid Louisiana Gas Co, Expansion, Completed, in service July 1998, LA, 25 mi, 22 in, 100 MMcf/d, cost 12 million, Interstate, FERC, docket listed as na. This is not P0187: the Midla Natchez Pipeline is a 52 mi, 12 in line built in 2017 under FERC docket CP15-523, which replaced the old Midla system. No row for the old Midla 22 inch mainline exists in the roster. The 25 mi would pass the length rule, but no start or end point could be found. Searches found no FERC order, operator release or other second source for a 1998 expansion; the Midla 22 inch mainline was later abandoned and replaced by Natchez, so the loop may no longer exist as operating pipe. Not staged. If pursued later, find the 1990s FERC certificate for Mid Louisiana Gas and check whether the loop is still in service.
